tickets.visual_thesis: Remeasurement produces a charge; the same printed entry physically enters the reported-loss statement while separate cash stays unchanged.
tickets.takeaway: Financing accounting changes affect reported loss; this does not mean cash was destroyed.

hero.kind: Charge emerging from an illustrative remeasurement press
hero.start_state: Charge not emitted yet; financing slip labels fair-value remeasurement without a preprinted amount
hero.action: Dario drives remeasurement press; printed charge detaches and follows a continuous arc into the statement pocket
hero.end_state: Selected financing charge included within a statement showing the fixed sourced reported net loss

layers.foreground: Actor hands where contact requires it; captions in screen space

camera.framing: Larger mechanical close-up, then upper statement payoff
camera.action: Press camera begins at1.15x and pushes to1.21x; press exits left/up after hand release while the sheet travels independently

actor.gaze_target: Dario tracks the sheet with bounded gaze; host morphs explain to point during flight

actor.occlusion: Actors stay foreground. Receipt route clears padded Dario head region; pocket lip covers sheet only at landing.
actor.reason: Preserve current guide position while the world moves

motion.anticipation: Crank winds back before forward drive
motion.settle: Paper lands in the statement pocket without changing its amount or the fixed reported total
motion.overlap: Print finishes at2.55s; release2.85s; press exit3–3.85s; sheet arrives4.55s leaving over1s for reading
